aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but incorrectly merges several distinct report sheets and changed factors.
issues: Changed factor combines unrelated tests: method change, magnet reduction, insert tape, and controller error.
Review title/purpose focus on insert tape while outcomes mostly use other sheets.
Insert tape comparison omits the key test row and conclusion from outcomes.
NG rate VP deform sheet has a separate controller-error comparison but is not properly modeled.
Measurement outcomes are auto-extracted headers/statistics, not verified comparable outcomes.
correctionPlan: Split into separate review cases or changed factors by sheet/report purpose.
Model Change method as normal dry UC press versus changed method, with vision, function, and tension outcomes.
Model reduce magnet as normal versus 1-magnet CD press JIG, preserving date totals and function checks.
Model insert tape as insert tape versus normal, including its NG-increase decision.
Model VP deform controller error as a separate cause check or exclude if not a validation comparison.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficient because grouping is wrong and key comparison rows are missing.
